newsitem.title: USA: NIMO restores power to 1,000 NY customers.
newsitem.headline: NIMO restores power to 1,000 NY customers.

text.p: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp (NIMO) said Tuesday the company restored electricity to 1,000 upstate New York customers whose service was disrupted by nearly two feet of snow dumped there overnight.
"Energy restoration has been completed," said NIMO spokesman Jim Cosgrove.
"We were hit pretty hard in Oswego County, north of Syracuse, primarily residential and small commercial customers," he said.
Oswego is one of 32 New York counties served by NIMO. The utility provides power to a total of 1.5 million customers.
The outages mainly were caused by overhead distribution lines snapping under the weight of heavy, wet snow.

Before Monday's outages, NIMO dispatched crews to repair power lines this past weekend when snow knocked out services in its western New York territory. It had already restored service to those affected customers.
